title: Understand hand-back, parking and restaffing
when: A launched turn returns or an existing worker needs a different level
need: A tool continuation handle is still running; a returned turn is not completion. Preserve the checkpoint and actual wake/park path. Changing a running worker level requires the supported successor/restaff path, not editing its live model. A headless worker whose process exited is resumed, not terminated: the relay resumes the same session for its next message, `yoke session-control session wake SESSION-ID` retries, and terminate is the last resort once that wake reports the transcript gone.
surface: Steer worker-launch -> worker-lifecycle/model-selection; session and launch evidence.
gap: Only the guidance chain was traced; individual harness wake and physical termination mechanics belong to runtime verification.
